item.title: Dr. Li Receives the 2026 Merit Award in Teaching and Advising
item.description: On October 1, 2026, Dr. Li received Elizabethtown College’s Merit Award in Teaching and Advising. He previously received this award in 2021.

item.title: Dr. Li Named Best Advisor of the Year for 2026
item.description: In April 2026, Dr. Li again received Elizabethtown College’s Best Advisor of the Year award, after first receiving it in 2024. Only two faculty members received this award.

item.title: Dr. Li Named Best Advisor of the Year
item.description: In April 2024, Dr. Li received Elizabethtown College’s Best Advisor of the Year award. Only two faculty members received this award.

item.title: Dr. Li Promoted to Associate Professor
item.description: Effective July 2023, Dr. Peilong Li was promoted to Associate Professor in the Department of Computer Science at Elizabethtown College.

item.title: Dr. Li Receives the Merit Award in Teaching and Advising
item.description: In May 2021, Dr. Li received Elizabethtown College’s Merit Award in Teaching and Advising. Only three faculty members in the whole college received this award.

item.title: Dr. Li Receives the Merit Award in Scholarship and Professional Activity
item.description: In May 2020, Dr. Li received Elizabethtown College’s Merit Award in Scholarship and Professional Activity. Only three faculty members in the whole college received this award.
